candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Arm I (nivolumab, relatlimab): Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes followed by relatlimab IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of each cycle.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must be in first recurrence of glioblastoma following radiation therapy and temozolomide

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Arm I (nivolumab, relatlimab): Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes followed by relatlimab IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as nivolumab, may help the body's immune system attack the tumor, and may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Arm I (nivolumab, relatlimab): Patients receive nivolumab IV over 30 minutes followed by relatlimab IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of each cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Relatlimab is a monoclonal antibody that may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

role_evidence.quote: [ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Arm II (lomustine): Patients receive lomustine PO on day 1 of each cycle.

source_quote.quote: No IDH mutation (IDH1 R132H negative by immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] or sequencing)

coder_notes: Nivolumab + relatlimab vs lomustine; both antibodies are investigational in Arm I. Surgery/biopsy and biospecimen collection are planned but no tumour PK or pharmacodynamic endpoint is registered.
